frontier_selector.why: The champion, Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease, is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive for evidence, including coagulative necrosis with frequent karyorrhexis and a lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate, which is not shared with other finalists.
